paper.title: Raissi, Yazdani & Karniadakis (2020), Hidden fluid mechanics
paper.scope: Reduced HFM transport mechanism: constant incompressible velocity and constant pressure satisfy unforced Navier-Stokes by construction. Neural tracer plus2 velocity coefficients; not full spatial velocity/pressure reconstruction, no biomedical benchmark reproduction.

sources.name: Raissi, Yazdani & Karniadakis (2020), Hidden fluid mechanics
sources.text: Primary paper project: hidden velocity and pressure from passive-scalar observations with transport and Navier-Stokes physics. Our small experiment isolates transport-based identification within a constant-velocity family; it does not recover general spatial flow or pressure fields.

sources.name: Twelve CPU tracer-identification controls and held-out checks
sources.text: Neural concentration, periodic inputs, bounded outputs, two velocity parameters, full/noisy/data-only/stripe controls. Constant flow and constant pressure satisfy Navier-Stokes and continuity by construction. All final velocities, concentration fields and initial values retained.
